customManagers.description: Containerfile ARG pins annotated with a renovate comment; the optional _COMMIT ARG is bumped together with the version because the build checks out by commit, not tag

packageRules.description: Let upstream exiftool releases settle before they are proposed
An Alpine minor/major bump also needs the Repology package names and Perl pins moved by hand, so it must not merge unattended
prBodyNotes: Also move the `alpine_3_XX/*` Repology names and the Perl pins; see AGENTS.md
